hook.name: CoalaXLayerHook
hook.description: A buy/sell tax hook for factory-launched token pools on XLayer that applies a fixed 1% tax on swaps using BeforeSwapReturnsDelta and AfterSwapReturnsDelta. Tax proceeds are minted as ERC-6909 claims on the pool manager. Only pools registered by the CoalaXLayerFactory are permitted to swap; donations are blocked outright.
